about_the_game:
Welcome to Brioche's Bakery in Aldeera!

You are Asher a small one-eyed catlike creature that has a deep passion for food, and a Bakery offers free food for the simplest job ever! Sorting!

In this game, you control Asher to sort various pastries in columns! As you complete all the columns in the board, the character in the right will 'Grow'... So sort as fast as possible to see how big you can get them to become!

Content

This is our first Steam game! The playtime will vary depending on your efficiency in sorting. My personal playtime is around 10-15 minutes per character!

Once you complete a level you will unlock a full NSFW image of a character! But there is another image that you can get by obtaining Perfect criteria on each character!

Fetishes

Please note, this game contains fetishes about belly inflation, feedism and milking!

This games contains the following:

  • A short intro containing 4-5 drawings per character showcasing how they found and joined Brioche's bakery! 

  • A total of 27 drawings, 9 per character, you start with a basic drawing of a character and as you progress it will show the next one, which includes the character becoming lewder and bigger!

  • 2 Full drawings of each character, a Standard one which is won by seeing all 8 progression images of that character, and a Perfect one that is obtained by finishing the first 9 levels before the timer runs out!

  • 11 Running Fractals that will randomly spawn and run across the screen! They don't affect the gameplay, but aren't they cute? Try to see them all! (Purely random)

Gameplay

You can move left and right, and use the the interact button (space in computer, X/A in controller) to take or place a pastry. You must organize the pastries so you form all of them into columns of 6 each. Once you finish 9 levels, you will unlock the standard CG and perfect CG if you beat it before the timer ended! After this, you can keep playing indefinitely until you return to the main menu to try out the other levels! 

There are 3 different levels! We present our staff!

Brioche

The owner of the bakery, loves money and can't wait to get you to work! This game mode is the basic mode, where you sort your pastries to gain points!

Ichigoko

A phoenix from a different world! She's super excited to work here, but be careful! When you grab a pastry, it will start burning... Leave it alone for too long and Fwoosh it will burn!... But don't worry, you can still make it into a column, but it will net you less points!

Aethra

A wandering star who loves experimenting new things! She has done many weird things before for money or food, so when she saw the "Free food" sign, she had 0 doubts and went in! Aethra's powers will turn all the pastries in the board into stars for a brief moment! So memorize it well, and sort away!

Thanks!

Whether you bought our game, or did not... Thank you for reading here! It's our first steam upload, so we are nervous and excited to see how it goes! Have an amazing day!

- Fractal
